title: Reading the treble staff: The Final Countdown from the music

blocks.text:
You know the riff's keys and its rhythm. Now you'll read them from music, the way most songs are written down.

**By the end** you can read A B C D E F on the treble staff at sight and play the riff from the music.

blocks.title: The riff's rhythm
blocks.about: Rhythm mode: any key counts; only the timing is judged. Once through.

blocks.text:
# The staff
Music is written on a **staff**: five lines and the four spaces between them. A note sits **on a line** (the line through its middle) or **in a space**. Higher on the staff is higher on the keyboard: one step up, line to space or space to line, is the next white key up.

The **treble clef** at the start curls round the second line up: notes on that line are the G above middle C. The right hand usually reads this staff.

The riff's notes, from the bottom:

- **A** in the second space,
- **B** on the middle line,
- **C** in the third space,
- **D** on the fourth line,
- **E** in the top space,
- **F** on the top line.

blocks.caption: The riff's first four bars. ▶ to hear them; watch the notes light on the staff.

blocks.title: A to F on the staff
blocks.doneWhen: 16 of the 20 cards clean in one set

blocks.text:
# Steps and skips
Good readers read the **shape**. A **step** is to the next line or space (the next key); a **skip** is line to line or space to space (skipping a key). The riff is mostly steps, E D E, and one big leap: from E down to A, the top space to the second space.

Counting letters, from E down to A is a **5th** (E D C B A): the riff's leap. Bigger intervals on the staff: a **4th** goes line to space or space to line, two keys between; a **5th** goes line to line or space to space, three keys between.

# The riff from the music
In **Wait for me** the music waits for each note. On a phone, hold it upright to play on the screen's keys, or connect a keyboard.

blocks.title: The riff, from the music
blocks.about: Wait for me, right hand, bars 1–8.

blocks.title: The riff in time
blocks.about: Play along at ♩ 90: notes and timing judged.
blocks.doneWhen: 80% of the notes on time in one run

blocks.text:
# If this happens
- **You mix up E and F.** E is in the top space, F on the top line.
- **You count up from the bottom for every note.** Learn two landmarks: B on the middle line, F on the top line.

**Until the next lesson:** the note cards for a minute, then the riff from the music.
